setup.welcomeText: Turn meeting transcripts and existing diagrams into clean BPMN 2.0 process maps, then into reports that show where to cut cost, close compliance gaps and reduce risk.
setup.aiText: SuperProcess uses a language model to read your material. Files go from this device straight to the AI you choose; there is no SuperProcess server in between.
setup.skipHint: You can explore the app with a sample process and connect an AI later in Settings.
setup.readyTextAi: {{provider}} is connected. Drop a transcript or a diagram to map your first process.
setup.readyTextDemo: No AI is connected yet. You can open the sample process to see what SuperProcess produces, and connect an AI at any time in Settings.

ai.cloudText: Best quality. Needs an API key and an internet connection; usage is billed by the provider.
ai.localText: Private and free. Runs on this computer through Ollama or LM Studio; quality depends on your hardware.
ai.keyStored: Stored only on this device and sent only to {{provider}}.
ai.effortHint: Higher effort is more thorough and takes longer.
ai.contextHint: How much text the model reads at once. Longer material is condensed first. Larger values need more memory.
ai.ollamaInstallHint: Install it from ollama.com, start it, then check again.
ai.ollamaOrigin: Using SuperProcess in a browser tab? Ollama only answers sites it trusts. Set the environment variable OLLAMA_ORIGINS to {{origin}} and restart Ollama. The desktop app needs no such setting.
ai.noModels: No models installed yet. Download one below.
ai.lmstudioHint: In LM Studio, open the Developer tab, start the local server, load a model and turn on CORS.
ai.customHint: Any server that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions protocol.

home.title: Map a process
home.subtitle: Add a meeting transcript, notes or an existing diagram. SuperProcess maps the process in BPMN 2.0 and delivers it in the format you choose.
home.dropTitle: Drop files here, or click to browse
home.notesPlaceholder: For example: the company and area, the scope to map, regulations that apply, terms to use…
home.analyzeNeedsAi: Connect an AI in Settings to analyze your own files.
home.demoText: Connect an AI to map your own processes. Meanwhile, the sample shows what you get.
home.historyDelete: Delete this analysis and its reports?
home.fileLegacyVisio: {{name}} is in the old Visio format. Open it in Visio and save it as .vsdx.
home.fileAudio: {{name}} is an audio or video file. Add its transcript instead (.vtt, .srt, .txt, .docx).
home.fileImage: {{name}} is an image. Add the diagram file itself or a transcript.
home.fileBinary: {{name}} is not a supported file type.

format.vsdxHint: Editable drawing with glued connectors and shape data (.vsdx)
format.bpmnHint: For Camunda, Bizagi, Signavio, bpmn.io and other BPMN tools (.bpmn)
format.svgHint: Vector image for documents and the web

working.title: Mapping your process
working.hint: Cloud models usually need less than a minute. Local models can take several minutes.

error.auth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
error.rateLimit: The AI provider is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
error.network: The AI could not be reached. Check your internet connection.
error.networkLocal: The local AI server could not be reached. Make sure it is running and accepts requests from this app.
error.modelNotFound: The model “{{model}}” is not available. Choose another one in Settings.
error.refusal: The AI declined to process this material.
error.truncated: The answer was cut off before it was complete. Try again with less material or a model with a larger output limit.
error.invalidOutput: The AI returned an answer that could not be used. Try again, or use a more capable model.
error.tooLong: The material is too long for this model. Use a model with a larger context window, or add fewer files.
error.badRequest: The AI provider rejected the request: {{message}}
error.server: The AI provider reported an error: {{message}}
error.notConfigured: No AI is connected. Set one up in Settings.

result.stepHint: Select a step in the diagram to see its details.

validation.noStartEvent: The process has no start event.
validation.noEndEvent: The process has no end event.
validation.startHasIncoming: Start event “{{node}}” has an incoming flow.
validation.endHasOutgoing: End event “{{node}}” has an outgoing flow.
validation.noIncoming: “{{node}}” has no incoming flow and can never be reached.
validation.noOutgoing: “{{node}}” has no outgoing flow: the process gets stuck there.
validation.unreachable: “{{node}}” cannot be reached from a start event.
validation.cannotReachEnd: No end event can be reached from “{{node}}”.
validation.eventGatewayTargets: Event-based gateway “{{node}}” must be followed by catching events or receive tasks.
validation.boundaryNoOutgoing: Boundary event “{{node}}” has no outgoing flow.
validation.superfluousGateway: Gateway “{{node}}” neither splits nor merges the flow.
validation.gatewayMixed: Gateway “{{node}}” merges and splits at once. Use separate gateways.
validation.splitFlowsUnlabeled: The flows leaving “{{node}}” should say when each path is taken.
validation.splitUnnamed: A decision gateway has no name. Name it as a question.
validation.implicitSplit: “{{node}}” has several outgoing flows. A gateway should show whether one path or all are taken.
validation.implicitMerge: Several flows arrive directly at “{{node}}”. A merging gateway would make this explicit.
validation.duplicateName: Two activities in the same lane are both called “{{node}}”.
validation.multipleStarts: The process has several plain start events.
validation.parallelFlowLabeled: Parallel gateway “{{node}}” has conditions on its flows, but all paths are always taken.
validation.multipleDefaults: Gateway “{{node}}” has more than one default flow.
validation.largeDiagram: The diagram has {{count}} elements. Consider splitting it into sub-processes.
validation.messageTaskWithoutMessage: “{{node}}” sends or receives a message but is not linked to an external party.

repair.laneCreated: Created lane “{{name}}”, which a step referred to.
repair.nodeLaneDefaulted: “{{node}}” had no lane and was placed in the first one.
repair.flowDropped: Removed a flow with a missing or invalid end ({{from}} → {{to}}).
repair.selfLoopRemoved: Removed a flow from “{{node}}” to itself.
repair.gatewayRemoved: Removed gateway “{{node}}”, which neither split nor merged.
repair.boundaryDetached: Boundary event “{{node}}” had no activity to attach to.
repair.externalRemoved: Removed external party “{{name}}”, which exchanged no messages.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Choose one or more angles. Each report is written from the process map and your original material, and can be saved on its own.
reports.customDescription: Describe the angle of analysis yourself.
reports.customPlaceholder: What should this report analyse? For example: readiness for ISO 9001 certification, or the impact of moving to a shared service centre.
reports.instructionsPlaceholder: Frameworks to check against (SOX, ISO 27001, LGPD…), the audience, the level of detail…
reports.needAi: Connect an AI in Settings to generate reports.
reports.empty: No reports yet. Pick the angles that matter and generate them together.

cost.name: Cost reduction
cost.description: Cost drivers, waste and where to save.

lean.name: Lean waste analysis
lean.description: Value-adding versus non-value-adding work, the eight wastes.

bottlenecks.name: Bottlenecks and lead time
bottlenecks.description: Where work waits and what sets the total time.

automation.name: Automation and AI opportunities
automation.description: What to automate, how, and what it takes.

compliance.name: Compliance gaps
compliance.description: Requirements versus the process, missing controls and records.

audit.name: Auditability
audit.description: Evidence, approval trails and traceability of each case.

risk.name: Risk and internal control
risk.description: Risk and control matrix, segregation of duties.

privacy.name: Data protection (LGPD / GDPR)
privacy.description: Personal data touchpoints, purposes, sharing and retention.

resilience.name: Continuity and resilience
resilience.description: Single points of failure and fallbacks.

quality.name: Quality and error-proofing
quality.description: Where errors arise, rework loops and prevention.

cx.name: Customer experience
cx.description: The process through the customer's eyes.

roles.name: Roles and responsibilities (RACI)
roles.description: Who is responsible and accountable, hand-offs and gaps.

systems.name: Systems and data
systems.description: System landscape, manual re-entry and integration gaps.

kpi.name: KPIs and measurement
kpi.description: Indicators to manage the process and where the data comes from.

maturity.name: Process maturity
maturity.description: Maturity level by dimension and the path to the next level.

sop.name: Process documentation (SOP)
sop.description: A procedure a new employee could follow.

executive.name: Executive overview
executive.description: A balanced health check with the top priorities.

tobe.name: Redesign proposal (to-be)
tobe.description: How the process should run, change by change.

report.mapCaption: Steps with findings are highlighted. The number is the count of findings for the step.
report.disclaimer: Written by SuperProcess with {{model}} on {{date}}. This analysis was generated by AI from the material provided; review it before acting on it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacy: Analyses, settings and API keys are stored only on this device. Your files are sent only to the AI you connected, and with a local model they never leave this computer.
settings.clearConfirm: Delete every analysis and report stored on this device?
settings.resetConfirm: Delete all analyses, settings and the stored API key?
